nodes.name: Claude — Plan Routes
nodes.notes: continueOnFail so a Claude API failure doesn't kill the whole workflow with no response ever sent back — retrying is left entirely to the orchestrator (orchestrator/run_session.js), which classifies retryable vs non-retryable errors; n8n's own blind retry-on-fail is intentionally not used here — see Parse Route Plan for how the error is turned into a clean {error: ...} reply instead of a raw n8n 500.
